title: Predication shape
description: JSON Schema for a predication-shape — the signature of a structure-form expressed as a finite list of characteristic predication cells. An entity inhabits the form iff its cell-graph supplies a witnessing cell for each characteristic cell at the prescribed cardinality. The list-and-cardinality form, per the theorem in code/structures/predication-shape.md, is the uniform reduction of sort/operation/relation/constant signature data when the interpretation category is the predication category P.

form.description: Optional structure-form slug naming what this shape is the signature of.

characteristic-cells.description: The list of characteristic cells. Each tuple (predicate, subject-sort, object-sort, cardinality) declares a required-or-optional incident cell on entities inhabiting the form.

predicate.description: The predicate at this characteristic cell. Must be in the ambient predicate-category.

subject-sort.description: Optional sort-slug constraining admissible subjects. When absent, any entity may be the subject.

object-sort.description: Optional sort-slug constraining admissible objects. When absent, any entity may be the object.

cardinality.description: Required cardinality of the witnessing cell-set: 'required' (exactly one), 'optional' (zero or one), 'list-valued' (zero or more), or 'set-valued' (zero or more distinct).
